sentences.text: Mira, an 8-year-old spayed female Domestic Shorthair, has a live safety flag: every z/d feeding was refused from Jun 5 to 19, 30 in a row, with 34 of 38 rated feedings refused, and the trial was stopped on day 19 of 42.
Intake not directly observed: a free-fed Purina ONE bowl was down, and in cats 48 to 72 hours of markedly reduced intake is a hepatic-lipidosis risk window.
Weight is −6.8% in 18 days, 4.4 to 4.1 kg on 2 home-scale readings; rounded to 0.1 kg, the true loss lies between 4.6% and 9.0%.
Vomiting has 5 entries on 5 of 19 logged days, and the record ends Jun 19, 13 days before this report.
